msa.unit: distinct corrupted output: design mutants (a miss if any of 5 instruments admits), one-byte out/ corruptions, kernel literal perturbations, DOE corruptions, deleted plan orders

msa.unit: receipt bound to an ancestor subject (30) or a perturbed bench tree digest (40)
